svg.title: Triangle radial patterns: twelve construction studies
svg.desc: Original schematic geometric proposals accompanying the 2026-10-25 survey. Historical inspirations are adaptations, not reproductions.

g.text: 12 original construction sketches / candidate numbers match the 20-candidate survey / 2026-10-25
Geometry and color are authored for comparison. Gutters reveal cells. These sketches are not new Izzi API outputs.
